ns2:section.sectionText: Course is for Information Science majors providing a more in-depth exploration, engagement, and development within the iSchool. The focus is on professional development and career exploration by connecting and engaging students with various speakers and concepts, and introducing them to different career pathways. Each session will have a different group of speakers, which may include: employers, recruiters, alumni, current students, faculty, and campus staff. Course is relevant for undergraduate students at all stages of their academic career. May be repeated (limit of 3 experiential hours count towards IS electives). Always restricted to declared Information Sciences Majors. For more information about this major, please visit: http://go.ischool.illinois.edu/BSIS. Questions may be sent to bsis-advising@illinois.edu.
